Contracts

ARMY

Lockheed Martin Corp., Bethesda, Maryland, was awarded a $58,432,100 firm-fixed-price contract for M270 rocket launcher upgrades. Bids were solicited via the internet with three received. Work will be performed in Camden, Arkansas, with an estimated completion date of March 15, 2027. Fiscal 2026 procurement funds in the amount of $58,432,100 were obligated at the time of award. U.S. Army Contracting Command, Redstone Arsenal, Alabama, is the contracting activity (W31P4Q-26-C-0045).

General Dynamics Land Systems Inc., Sterling Heights, Michigan, and BAE Systems Land and Armaments L.P., York, Pennsylvania, have been awarded a $210,500,000 modification (P00012) to a previously awarded firm-fixed-price contract, bringing the total cumulative face value to $1,340,000,000, for Abrams tank sustainment. Work will be performed in Sterling Heights, Michigan, and York, Pennsylvania, with an estimated completion date of September 30, 2028. U.S. Army Contracting Command, Warren, Michigan, is the contracting activity (W56HZV-22-D-0010).

NAVY

Huntington Ingalls Industries Inc., Newport News, Virginia, is awarded a $1.2 billion cost-plus-incentive-fee contract for the construction of one Virginia-class submarine. Work will be performed in Newport News, Virginia, with completion date is December 31, 2032. Naval Sea Systems Command, Washington, District of Columbia, is the contracting activity (N00024-26-C-2101).

AIR FORCE

Boeing Co., Berkeley, Missouri, was awarded a $12,750,000 indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity contract for F-15EX technical data. This is a sole-source acquisition. Air Force Life Cycle Management Center, Wright-Patterson Air Force Base, Ohio, is the contracting activity.

DEFENSE LOGISTICS AGENCY

Valley Forge Fabrics Inc., Winston-Salem, North Carolina, has been awarded a maximum $45,000,000 ceiling firm-fixed-price, indefinite-delivery requirements contract for aircraft textiles. Location of performance is North Carolina, with a completion date of August 14, 2027. Using military services are Army, Navy and Air Force. Type of appropriation is fiscal 2026 through fiscal 2031 defense working capital funds. The contracting activity is the Defense Logistics Agency Troop Support, Philadelphia, Pennsylvania (SPE1C1-26-D-1234).
